results.note: Quaestiones de Trinitate et de Genesi - No standalone English translation found. A related work (De fide S. Trinitatis) appears in a Corpus Christianorum critical edition (Knibbs & Matter, 2012) with Latin text and English introduction, but not a full English translation.

Commentaria in Apocalypsin - S. Van Der Pas published 'Alcuin of York on Revelation: Commentary and the Questions and Answers Manual' (Consolamini Commentary Series, 2015) with English and Latin text.
Commentaria super Ecclesiasten - No English translation found. A Carolingian epitome was edited by D'Imperio (2008) but no English translation identified.
Epistolae - Stephen Allott's 'Alcuin of York, c. A.D. 732 to 804: His life and letters' (York, 1974) includes English translations of selected letters. Based on Dümmler's MGH edition.
In Evangelium Joannis - Latin text available on Wikisource; no English translation found in published sources.
Interpretationes nominum Hebraicorum - Work on Hebrew names of Christ's ancestors; no English translation found. Related to Jerome's tradition but Alcuin's own version remains untranslated.
Super III epistolas Pauli - Alcuin's commentary on Titus, Philemon, and partial coverage of Galatians/Colossians through Hebrews; no English translation found.
Adversus haeresin Felicis - 72-section refutation of Adoptionist heresy by Felix of Urgel; no English translation found in published sources.
Ars grammatica - Early medieval grammar text; no complete modern English translation found. A CCMC critical edition is planned but not yet published.

Carmina - David Pucci, 'The Poetry of Alcuin of York: A Translation with Introduction and Commentary' (Routledge Later Latin Poetry, 2021). First complete poetic translation in any language (339 poems, ~7,000 lines).
Confessio fidei - Work on faith/creed composed c. 800; no English translation found in modern published sources.
Contra Elipandum - Four books against Elipandus (proponent of Adoptionism); no English translation found.
Contra Felicem Urgellitanum - Seven books against Felix of Urgel written c. 798-800; no English translation found.
De caeremoniis baptismi - Short treatise on baptismal ceremonies; no English translation found.
De confessione peccatorum - Brief work on confession of sins; no English translation found.
De cursu et saltu lunae - Treatise on lunar cycles and calculations; no English translation found.
De dialectica - Dialogue between Charlemagne and Alcuin on dialectic vs. rhetoric; no English translation found.

De fide S. Trinitatis - Eric Knibbs and E. Ann Matter edited 'Alcuini Eboracensis De fide Sanctae Trinitatis et de incarnatione Christi' (Corpus Christianorum Continuatio Mediaevalis 249, Brepols 2012) with Latin text and extensive English introduction/apparatus. Whether this counts as 'translated' depends on whether critical edition apparatus suffices.
De grammatica - Educational grammar text (variant title/duplicate of Ars grammatica); no complete English translation found.
De incarnatione Christi - May be included in the Knibbs & Matter Corpus Christianorum edition (2012) alongside De fide S. Trinitatis. Treated similarly to 3672.
De orthographia - Alcuin's spelling/orthography guide with word glosses; no English translation found.
De processione Spiritus Sancti - Treatise on Filioque theology; no English translation found.

De ratione animae - James Joseph Mark Curry's dissertation 'Alcuin, De Ratione Animae: a text with introduction, critical apparatus, and translation' (Cornell University, 1966) includes English translation.

De rhetorica et virtutibus - Wilbur Samuel Howell, 'The Rhetoric of Alcuin & Charlemagne: A Translation' (Princeton University Press, 1941; reissued Russell & Russell, 1965). Also published as 'A Translation of Alcuin's Disputatio de rhetorica et virtutibus, with introduction and notes.'
De usu Psalmorum - Treatise on the use/interpretation of Psalms; no English translation found.

De virtutibus et vitiis - Rachel Stone published an English translation in The Heroic Age (2015): 'Translation of Alcuin's De Virtutibus et Vitiis Liber.' Earlier draft translations exist on Academia.edu but Stone's publication is the primary copyrighted version.

Epistola Alcuini ad filiam in Christo - This letter may be included in Stephen Allott's selection of translated letters (1974), but no specific confirmation of this particular letter's inclusion found.
Liber sacramentorum - Alcuin's sacramentary collection; no English translation found. Distinct from later Schuster's 'Liber Sacramentorum' commentary.
Officia per ferias - Liturgical offices for weekdays; no English translation found.
Vita B. Richardi - Life of the Blessed Richard; no English translation found.

Vita S. Martini Turonensis - Life of Saint Martin of Tours; no direct English translation identified. (Note: Alcuin is credited with revising an earlier vita; Peter Godman's 'Bishops, Kings, and Saints of York' is a different work.)
Vita S. Vedasti - Life of Saint Vedast; no English translation found.

Vita S. Willibrodi - Charles H. Talbot's translation in 'The Anglo-Saxon Missionaries in Germany' (Sheed and Ward, 1954) and also available in abridged form on the Fordham Medieval Sourcebook (fordham.edu).
Enchiridion - Alcuin's compendium of monastic and moral teachings (c. 800); no modern English translation found. A critical edition is in preparation but not yet published.
In Cantica canticorum - Commentary on Song of Songs; no English translation found.

Interrogationes et responsiones in Genesin - Alcuin's Q&A commentary on Genesis. An Old English translation by Ælfric of Eynsham exists (medieval, not modern English). No modern English translation of Alcuin's Latin original found.
